figures.label: measured (October provisional: late cancellations post for two weeks)
figures.method: Each booked line whose margin on booked COGS is under its band's hand-set floor of that day (rebuilt from the band edits in the audit log) lifted to the floor at the same units, both KS layers, tool scope (no outlet, Apple, Starlink; the June/July analysis in the main repo, Jun 24,400 and Jul 15,100, included them). Each line gets the first cause that fits: 0 campaign day; 1 its SKU in a live markdown batch; 2 a GjirafaMall SKU listed on Gjirafa50, which takes Gjirafa50's price; 3 above the floor before an order-level voucher; 4 cross-dock sold under its booked cost; 5 no calculator price live for the SKU that day; 6 sold more than 2 % under the calculator's live price; 7 at the calculator's price but under the floor on booked cost. Aug-Sep: 2954 a month is allowed or not a price (dead stock, vouchers); the rest sits in the lanes of levers 1, 3 and 5, partly on Gjirafa50's side of shared SKUs (cause 2: 3459 a month under Gjirafa50's own floor, 1851 under cost). Cause 5 as context only: on SKUs today's engine run raises, about 1648 a month (Mall 300, Gj50 1348), a proxy (August's runs weren't kept), not in the sheet. The totals equal PricingTool.AgentTools backtest-below-floor 1 4.

figures.name: Cost watcher on the first real cost refresh (31 Oct 2026, both KS layers)
figures.label: measured
figures.method: The replica's costs refreshed that morning; the feed read the costs of the SKUs no other rule owns that sit near their floor, and 293 had moved at least 0.5 % from the engine run's. No rise was raised: 102 of the 156 rises left the live price above its floor, 52 put it under but the price was a cheaper team deal (held for a person: the publisher leaves those alone), and 2 had a floor above max(anchor, current) (held: the regular price needs changing); no jump looked like a data error. The rebuild spanned two polls: 168 of the 461 observations were the same moves seen again (each held a second time); the feed now skips a cost already observed since the run. Ten observations were checked by hand against the engine run (hours.md, 31 Oct).
